text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. Have you seen Urara-san 
anywhere?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I see. Honestly, right in the middle of 
her training, too...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
The other day, Teio-chan and Tsuro-chan 
helped out an underclassman who was in 
trouble! But I couldn't do anything 
helpful at all.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I wanna become a senpai that people can 
rely on a whole lot more! So— I want 
King-chan to teach me all sorts of things!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Coming to rely on me, you certainly know 
who to ask! In that case, leave everything 
to this King!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Thank you, King-chan!! If King-chan 
is the one teaching me, everything will 
definitely be fine!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
'Cause you're kind, cool, and super-duper 
dependable! I wanna become just like 
King-chan!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Just like me, you say... Fufu, very well! 
I shall train you step-by-step from head 
to toe! Be sure you keep up with me!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
And so, I intended to bestow upon her the 
culture needed to support others, the 
stamina and patience to stand by their 
side, and the adaptability for every 
situation, but...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I told her to bring the reference 
book on great philosophers... Could she 
have gotten distracted by something else 
again?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Mr. Ladybug, over here, over here~~!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
There you are! Urara-san, what are you 
doing?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, King-chan! And Trainer-san! Umm, you 
see, I was putting back books that had 
fallen on the floor. And then—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
There was a ladybug by the window! It 
looked like it really wanted to go 
outside, so I brought it out here!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Didn't I tell you to bring the 
philosophy book? What happened to the 
book?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
The book?! I forgot~! I'm sorry, 
King-chan! I'll go get it right away!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Next is observing the underclassmen's 
training. Observe each and every one to 
see what they are lacking... And determine 
individually how you ought to supplement 
their needs!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Determine it individually, got it! All 
right, let's do this~~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, that cloud looks like carrot ice 
cream. I'm getting hungry...
choice_data_list: What happened to observing the training?
What happened to observing the training?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah?! Oh right, I have to watch 
properly!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Whenever there's something interesting, I 
end up looking away right away~. Ehehe.

King Halo also mentioned that she tends to 
get easily distracted. Isn't there some 
way to keep Haru Urara focused on her 
training—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
King-chan would never look away!! She 
always stays right by my side and cheers 
me on for my sake!
choice_data_list: Then you have to imitate her, right?
Then you have to imitate her, right?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh! You're right! I have to become just 
like King-chan!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Urara-san! Cook a delicious dish 
using that carrot! You have three minutes! 
Let us see your adaptability!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Waaah, this carrot looks so sweet. 
Maybe I'll take a nibble—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, no! King-chan would never sneak 
snacks while cooking!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ummm... first, let's wash the carrot! Mr. 
Carrot, I'm gonna wash you all clean~~!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh my... Fufu, that is a good trend.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huff... haaah... whew... Not yet... I 
won't... give up halfway... through...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That is right! Even if the distance seems 
impossible at first glance, believe that 
you can do it and keep moving your legs! 
To accomplish something, believing in 
yourself is paramount!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
—And then, stand close beside the other 
person. Never forget that feeling above 
all else.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... haaah... Did I... get better at 
supporting someone?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Who knows? That is entirely up to you. 
However, I am not worried. After all, you 
received personal instruction from none 
other than myself!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yup! Leave it to me! Just like King-chan, 
I'll do my absolute best!
